text: Thank you for providing your history; your 44-year smoking pack-year history combined with chronic bronchitis is significant given your fatigue, weight loss, and edema. DIAGNOSIS READY: Membranoproliferative Glomerulonephritis (or Secondary Glomerulonephritis).

The urinalysis showing 4+ protein, numerous fatty casts, and negative blood/glucose confirms severe nephrotic syndrome, likely driven by your chronic inflammation or smoking history, rather than heart failure or pneumonia.
